prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 二维合并 · 采购评审 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "甲、乙两家报价接近，建议进入第二轮商务谈判，重点" spans 1 col × 2 row; "未按要求提交完整报价文件，视为无效投标" spans 3 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "供应商" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "报价" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 65px
  col 3: header "交期" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 38px
  col 4: header "质保" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "评审意见" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 582px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 441px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 440px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较三家供应商的采购报价、交期和质保，并记录评审结论。","reading":"读者先按供应商横向查看条件，再纵向比较甲、乙两家的数值；共享意见将两家联系起来，丙家的合并单元格说明其投标无效。","groups":["报价、交期和质保是可并列比较的采购条件，列宽应足以让有效报价及单位保持完整。","供应商与评审意见分别承担行标识和结论说明的作用；意见列需要较多空间容纳连续文字。"],"keep_intact":["供应商名称","金额及货币符号","交期和质保的数字与单位","简短结论“淘汰”"],"may_wrap":["甲、乙两家共享的长评审意见可自然换行，其高度由两行共同承担。","丙家横跨报价、交期和质保三列的无效投标说明可自然换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [67, 86, 59, 52, 176] · table 441×203px · row heights [36, 53, 53, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [62, 86, 59, 52, 181] · table 441×239px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [67, 86, 59, 55, 173] · table 441×226px · row heights [36, 65, 65, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"供应商、金额、交期和质保均保持完整，表头清楚；共享意见分四行，由甲、乙两行共同承载，丙家的无效投标说明也容易阅读。","problems":"意见列文字较密，但仍有清楚的行与列的区分。","cause":"前四列分别为67、86、59、52px，恰好容纳各自需要保持完整的内容；剩余176px分给意见列，使共享意见控制在四行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"意见列增加到181px，共享意见仍为四行，金额、交期和质保保持完整。","problems":"供应商表头及三家名称均断成两行，行标识难以快速辨认，表头和数据行也随之变高。","cause":"供应商列缩至62px，扣除21px后只有41px内容宽度，小于供应商表头和名称所需的46px；意见列增加的5px没有减少共享意见的行数。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"供应商及三项采购条件保持完整，表头不换行。","problems":"共享意见增至五行，甲、乙两行都变高，意见的阅读节奏也更零碎。","cause":"质保列从52px增至55px，但其内容不需要额外宽度；意见列因此缩至173px，触发额外换行。"}],"done":true,"designs":[]}
